summary: Phase 6 Backend Testing Complete - Events & Media APIs fully functional. All 33 tests passed including Auth endpoints, Event CRUD, Media Upload, RBAC, and validation tests.

minor.issue: Communities created before Phase 6 were missing 'privacy' and 'status' fields causing 500 errors. Fixed by adding default values to existing documents.

action_items: Consider adding a database migration script to ensure all existing communities have 'privacy' and 'status' fields with default values
critical_code_review_comments: Event routes properly implement RBAC - only super_admin and community_manager can manage events

Static file serving is properly configured at /api/media/events/
Auth supports both JWT (Authorization header) and cookie-based (session_token) authentication
All datetime fields are properly serialized/deserialized for MongoDB storage
seed_data_creation: Fixed existing communities by adding missing 'privacy' and 'status' fields via MongoDB update

GET /api/auth/me - with JWT and without auth
event_validation: Event date cannot be in past
media_upload: Media count and URLs in event response
